content:
Apple's highly anticipated AI smart glasses are expected to launch at the end of next year, and now finally have a projected announcement date.

Unveiling at WWDC27

Earlier this year, reports indicated that Apple's AI smart glasses could begin shipping by the end of 2027. According to Bloomberg reporter Mark Gurman's report today, that is still the case. However, we now know that Apple is currently striving to showcase these new glasses to the public at next year's Worldwide Developers Conference.

The timing of this announcement may reflect the future direction of Apple's AI glasses. Apple seems unlikely to launch a new device at WWDC without providing any way for developers to create software for it. Therefore, these glasses may, like the new Siri AI, integrate data and functionality from third-party apps, rather than being limited to Apple's own features.

If this is the case, it would be very similar to the launch of the Apple Vision Pro in 2023: the hardware and software were unveiled months in advance, allowing developers to build apps for the platform, while the final hardware was released later.

Privacy Concerns

One reason for the delay of Apple's glasses from its originally planned end-of-2026 release date is their ongoing efforts to address privacy issues. Existing similar products from companies like Meta have raised concerns, attracting criticism, opposition, and even bans, due to worries that glasses equipped with cameras pose privacy risks. According to Gurman's report, Apple is exploring multiple options. In addition to testing a device with no cameras at all, Apple is also considering a software-based solution:

Beyond these measures, Apple is reportedly also experimenting with a range of brand-new hardware and software-related privacy features not found in any existing products.

Summary

Apple's AI glasses will not feature any display, but are expected to be able to take photos, play music, converse with Siri, answer calls, and more. They are also expected to feature a unique and stylish design to stand out from competitors. Are you interested in this product? Let us know in the comments!
